FIELDS.NAME: Shutter & Lens Studio
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Shutter & Lens Studio, we specialize in providing high-quality photography services, focusing primarily on portrait, event, commercial, and product photography. Our operations are headquartered in a dedicated studio space, equipped with standard professional photography equipment to ensure the best possible results for our clients. 

We prioritize client satisfaction by implementing a structured booking system and maintaining open communication throughout the project workflow. Alongside our core photography services, we offer ancillary services such as makeup and hairstyling, which are provided in a supportive role to enhance our photography offerings without being the focus of our business. 

Our team consists of experienced photographers, assistants, and administrative staff who all contribute to creating memorable visual narratives for our clients. We ensure compliance with all local business, zoning, and health and safety regulations to maintain a safe and legally compliant operation. Moreover, we are committed to minimizing risk by avoiding the use of drones in our photography work and steering clear of any hazardous materials by not engaging in chemical processing.

As part of our risk management strategy, we maintain adequate insurance coverage for all staff and clients, which is integral to our operational integrity. Shutter & Lens Studio continually strives to deliver top-notch photography services while upholding the highest standards in safety and quality.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred on 08/15/2022 due to a client accident resulting in property damage, totaling $1,500. The claim has been settled. Additionally, on 04/10/2023, a theft incident resulted in a loss of $2,000 worth of photography equipment, currently in the claims process.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL Rated, Fire Resistant, 2-Hour Fire Rating
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with security fencing and watchpersons on-site during operating hours.
